summary.text: Mary Ann Perez is a Democratic state representative who has represented Texas House District 144 since 2017, after an earlier term from 2013 to 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mary Ann Perez earned a B.B.A. from the University of Houston-Downtown.
Perez served in the Texas House representing District 144 from 2013 to 2015 and returned to the seat in 2017.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Insurance and Transportation committees.
She advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; David Flores is the Republican candidate in the 2026 general election.
